_about: Complexity budget for the spine core, enforced by core/scripts/repo-lint (run from core-selftest). Caps are frozen at the 2026-10-08 sizes. Adding a command, a script or skill lines past a cap means removing something else first; raising a cap needs the commit message to say what was removed or why that is impossible. 'targets' are aspirations (docs/improvement-plan.md D4), not enforced.
